name: Undifferentiated Carcinoma of Stomach

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for Undifferentiated Gastric Carcinoma

criteria.description: Presence of poorly differentiated malignant epithelial cells lacking glandular or squamous differentiation on histology
Positive staining for cytokeratins (e.g., CK AE1/AE3) with absence of markers indicating differentiation (e.g., negative for neuroendocrine markers)
Exclusion of other gastric carcinoma subtypes such as signet ring cell carcinoma or lymphoma by morphology and immunophenotyping
Imaging evidence of gastric mass with local invasion or metastasis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of undifferentiated malignant epithelial cells with supportive immunohistochemical profile and exclusion of other gastric malignancies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of histology, immunohistochemistry, and clinical findings.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Palpable abdominal mass in epigastric region
Progressive dysphagia due to gastric outlet obstruction
searchTerms: worsening swallowing problems from stomach blockage
difficulty eating due to gastric outlet obstruction

common.symptomName: Unintentional weight loss exceeding 10% body weight
searchTerms: losing significant body weight without trying

occasional.symptomName: Occult gastrointestinal bleeding leading to iron deficiency anemia

searchTerms: fluid buildup in abdomen from cancer spread
abdominal swelling due to cancer fluid
jaundice due to bile duct obstruction
skin and eye yellowing from liver issues

laboratory: Microcytic hypochromic anemia due to chronic blood loss
Elevated carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and CA 19-9 tumor markers in some cases
imaging: Contrast-enhanced CT scan showing irregular gastric wall thickening with local invasion
Endoscopic ultrasound revealing hypoechoic mass with loss of normal gastric wall layers
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; frequent TP53 mutations reported in undifferentiated gastric carcinomas
other: Histopathology demonstrating sheets of undifferentiated malignant cells without gland formation
Immunohistochemistry positive for broad-spectrum cytokeratins, negative for neuroendocrine and lymphoid markers

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of signet ring cells with mucin vacuoles
Positive mucin stains (e.g., PAS, Alcian blue)

redFlags: Evidence of metastatic spread on imaging
references: Orphanet: Undifferentiated carcinoma of stomach - ORPHA:423786
WHO Classification of Tumors of the Digestive System, 5th Edition, 2019
